versions.changelog:
Initial release of brand-guidelines skill.

- Applies Anthropic’s official brand colors and typography to digital artifacts.
- Automatically uses Poppins for headings and Lora for body text, with system font fallbacks.
- Ensures smart color and font selection for readability and brand consistency.
- Cycles through brand accent colors for non-text shapes to maintain visual interest.
- Requires no additional font installation—works with existing system fonts for broad compatibility.
